name: arith_even_perfect_last_digit
statement: (n : ℕ) (he : Even n) (hp : n.Perfect) : n % 10 = 6 ∨ n % 10 = 8
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (he : Even n) (hp : n.Perfect), n % 10 = 6 ∨ n % 10 = 8
informal: Every even perfect number ends in 6 or 8 — by Euclid–Euler (Mathlib) n = 2^k(2^(k+1)-1) with 2^(k+1)-1 prime; k+1 = 2 or odd; reduce 2^k mod 10 by k mod 4.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), Even n → n.Perfect → n % 10 = 6 ∨ n % 10 = 8
